hero.desc1: Discover a unique fusion of traditional Central African gastronomy and charming accommodation, just steps from the Kigali Convention Center.
hero.desc2: Indulge in our famous Maboké and Rwandan specialties, prepared with passion by our chef.

home.aboutTitle: A Story of Passion and Sharing
home.aboutP1: Founded on August 16, 2025 by Oli Nganzi, an entrepreneur from the Central African diaspora, La Banguissoise was born from a strong ambition: to create a cultural and gastronomic bridge between Bangui and Kigali, one of the most dynamic cities in Africa.
home.aboutP2: Whether you are an expatriate, diplomat, business traveler or simply curious, our establishment welcomes you in a refined setting where the legendary hospitality of Central Africa meets Rwandan dynamism.
home.restaurantDesc: Central African specialties like the famous Maboké, and Rwandan delights.
home.hebergementDesc: Elegant rooms for a stay of gentleness and serenity.
home.platsDesc: A glimpse of our most appreciated culinary creations, blending Central African tradition with local influences.
home.chambresDesc: Spaces designed for your comfort, blending discreet elegance with modern amenities.
home.aProposKCC: A few steps from the Kigali Convention Center
